_readme: Short atmospheric reflection lines for the end-of-day screen. Pick is random. Keep them quiet — this is a contemplative beat, not a sermon.
lines: Tokyo settles. Somewhere a vending machine hums in an empty alley.
A train passes far below. The window glass cools against your forehead.
You think of one face from today. Just one. You pray for them by name.
The kanji on the sign across the street is one you didn't know last month.
Someone you don't know is laughing two floors up. The wall carries it down.
You wonder, briefly, what your supporters back home are doing right now.
The kettle clicks off. Steam in the small kitchen. Nothing else.
A neon sign blinks. Tokyo doesn't sleep — but tonight, you do.
You write one line in your journal. You close it before you read it back.
Tomorrow, you tell yourself, will be its own day.
